steps.name: without-socket
steps.stderr: cat: can't open '/host-data/my-secrets.txt': No such file or directory

steps.name: with-socket
steps.command:
docker run --rm \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  docker:cli \
  docker run --rm \
    -v "$DEMO_DIR:/host-data:ro" \
    alpine cat /host-data/my-secrets.txt
